findings.detail: Recomputed bytes/sha256/treeSha256 for all package inventories match current files, not only saved report.
Candidate v1 resource pins match current source bytes.
All manifest layout/JCL/proc copies are current ASCII and byte-identical to reference-authoring-input-v1.
Logical JSONL record images and sequential files are ASCII fixed-width at expected copybook lengths.
Compiled GnuCOBOL random READ by primary and alternate key succeeded for package XREFFILE; absent alternate key returned non-zero. This is an effective lookup, not a dump-only proof.
Fresh GnuCOBOL helper DUMP from current package indexed files matches logical raw SHA for every indexed DD.
verify-only exited 0 on an isolated copy; source package not modified by the probe.
Reset validated by mutating first workspace, preparing second fresh copy, comparing full package union and performing effective read from second copy.
Posting fixture bytes include both present and absent CARDXREF lookup candidates.
PARMFILE is explicit 10-byte 2022071800 and TCATBALF/ACCTFILE/DISCGRP bytes make zero and non-zero rate rows selectable.

Reporting has separate non-empty TRANFILE, zero-byte TRANFILE.empty, DATEPARM start/end bytes, and no precreated TRANREPT output; absent input remains a declared blocker rather than a materialized case.
All reviewed physical DD files and sidecars are present exactly for the candidate package scope.

limits: Review did not execute CardDemo business COBOL and did not create/approve expected outputs or campaign fixtures.
Declared families are applicable as technical selection/input families for current bytes; they are not complete business coverage claims.
Absent reporting input is only represented as a blocker/precondition, not executable bytes.
